paragraphs: Our mission is to accelerate the mastery of biology to advance human health. We are a life sciences technology company focused on building innovative products and solutions to interrogate, understand and master biology. Our integrated research solutions include instruments, consumables and software for analyzing biological systems at a resolution and scale that matches the complexity of biology. We have built deep expertise across diverse disciplines including chemistry, biology, hardware and software. Innovations in all of these areas have enabled the deployment of our rapidly expanding suite of products, which allow our customers to interrogate biological systems at previously inaccessible resolution and scale. Our products have enabled researchers to make fundamental discoveries across multiple areas of biology, including oncology, immunology and neuroscience.

Since launching our first product in mid-2015 through December 31, 2025, we have sold 8,046 instruments to researchers around the world, including academic and translational researchers and biopharmaceutical companies. Our revenue was $642.8 million and $610.8 million for the years ended 2025 and 2024, respectively, representing a year-over-year increase of 5%. We generated net losses of $43.5 million and $182.6 million for the years ended 2025 and 2024, respectively. In the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, we sold 1,007 and 1,073 instruments and 424,000 and 357,100 consumable reactions, respectively. To date, we estimate that more than 10,000 peer-reviewed articles have been published based on data generated using our products.

Resolution and Scale are the imperatives that underlie our products and technology. First, our solutions are designed to enable understanding biology at the right level of biological resolution, such as at the level of the single cell or at high spatial resolution of tissues and organs. Second, we believe that high resolution tools only become truly powerful when they are built into technologies with tremendous scale. Our products enable measuring millions of single cells or tissue sample positions. Each of our platforms is designed to interrogate a major class of biological information enabling researchers to understand the complexities of biology at a spatial and cellular level. Collectively, our platforms enable researchers to interrogate, understand and master biology at the appropriate resolution and scale.

Our single cell portfolio, powered by our Chromium platform, includes microfluidic chips and related consumables and our Chromium X Series and legacy Chromium instruments. The Chromium portfolio enables high-throughput analysis of individual biological components. Our Chromium instruments serve as precisely engineered reagent delivery systems, partitioning samples into individual components which can exceed one million. Each partition is paired with proprietary gel beads bearing unique barcodes that allow researchers to identify the contents of each partition and distinguish them from contents of other partitions. Once biological material in each partition is barcoded, they can then be pooled and sequenced together. Partitioning and barcoding gives researchers the ability to measure many discrete biological materials and/or perform many different experiments in parallel, providing tremendous resolution and scale. Chromium enables multiomic readouts including gene expression, protein (cell surface and intracellular), chromatin, V(D)J, CRISPR/guide RNAs (gRNAs) and antigens, has broad sample compatibility (formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE), fresh, fresh frozen, paraformaldehyde (PFA) fixed tissue, DSP/methanol fixed peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) and whole blood) and delivers high performance including high cell recovery rates (CRE), high sensitivity, robustness and reproducibility.
Our single cell portfolio also includes QuantumScale Single Cell RNA and Single Cell Methylation kits, which we obtained through our acquisition of Scale Biosciences, Inc. ("Scale Bio") in 2025.
Our spatial portfolio is powered by our Visium and Xenium platforms and aims to bring together the worlds of histology and genomics.

Our Visium platform. Our Visium platform empowers researchers to identify where biological components are located and how they are arranged with respect to each other, otherwise referred to as "spatial analysis." Our Visium platform uses high density DNA arrays which have DNA barcode sequences that encode the physical location of biological analytes within a sample, such as a tissue section, allowing the spatial location of the analytes to be "read out" using sequencing to create a visual map of the analytes across the sample. Similar to partitioning, spatial barcoding with large numbers of oligos on an array can unlock tremendous insights, providing high resolution molecular information to visualize the whole transcriptome and protein expression, paired with same section hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) or infrared (IR) imaging data, across biological tissues. The Visium platform includes our Visium CytAssist, an instrument designed to simplify and optimize the Visium solution workflow by facilitating the transfer of transcriptomic analytes from standard glass slides to Visium slides, as well as our HD WT Panel Gene Expression and HD 3' Gene Expression assays.
We also offer v2 WT Panel Gene Expression and v1 3' Gene Expression, which are our first-generation assays.

Our Xenium platform. Our Xenium platform for in situ analysis is designed to give scientists the ability not only to locate and type cells in their tissue context, but also to address a variety of specific questions based on previous knowledge of their sample potentially discovered using our Chromium and Visium platforms. Our Xenium Analyzer instrument enables researchers to detect and preserve the cellular location of hundreds of RNA targets directly in a fresh frozen or FFPE tissue section without the need for conventional sequencing, providing researchers with a detailed map of gene expression patterns without sacrificing resolution or target number. Xenium uses circularizable probes specific to target transcripts followed by enzymatic amplification to create a target for fluorescent probe hybridization. On the Xenium Analyzer, microscope images of the tissue detect the location of each fluorescent probe, which is then removed. Successive rounds of fluorescent probe hybridization, imaging and removal creates a unique optical signature that reveals the identity of the RNA at a location within each cell of a tissue. Available Xenium consumables include curated, validated and fit-for-purpose gene panels along with the ability to design custom gene sets.

Our software is essential to accelerating the mastery of biology. As our portfolios unlock new levels of resolution and scale, they generate entirely new types of data at greater volumes and complexity than ever before. That scale has required an entirely new level of instrument software and firmware sophistication to make instruments like Xenium a possibility. Cell Ranger, introduced alongside our Chromium platform, has become a trusted scRNA-seq processing pipeline in scientific literature. We have extended the same principles of accessibility, scalability and reliability across all our platforms, ensuring that researchers can move from raw data to discovery with ease. Today, we provide a comprehensive and scalable software ecosystem that supports every stage of the research workflow, from experiment planning to data processing to visualization and exploration. By removing barriers to adoption, our tools help researchers generate high-quality data, achieve repeatable success and seamlessly scale their experiments. Loupe Browser (Chromium and Visium) enables intuitive single-cell, spatial and multiomic data visualization, helping researchers explore gene expression, cellular interactions and more—turning complex datasets into interactive insights that accelerate discovery. Xenium Explorer enables intuitive in situ data visualization, allowing researchers to explore subcellular gene expression, spatial organization and tissue-scale patterns with ease. It transforms complex imaging and transcriptomic data into interactive insights, accelerating discovery in spatial biology. Our goal is to expand this ecosystem through strategic partnerships that integrate powerful software tools designed to further democratize access to complex data analysis and accelerate the translation of biological insights into research and clinical advances.

We believe much of the $75 billion annual global life sciences research tools market is ultimately accessible to us due to our ability to answer a broad diversity of biological questions. We estimate a total addressable market of more than $21 billion annually, assuming every lab or company in the global life sciences research tools market were to adopt our solutions at spend levels comparable to our existing users. We estimate a serviceable addressable market of more than $13 billion annually,

assuming every lab or company in the global life sciences research tools market that is currently using single cell, spatial or adjacent research techniques were to adopt our solutions at spend levels comparable to our existing users. We also expect to pursue additional opportunities that may further expand our opportunity, including new versions and potential applications of our single cell, spatial and in situ technologies in the future. Our estimates are based on our own and third-party analyses of our potential opportunities. See the section titled "Risk Factors — The size of the market for our solutions may be smaller than estimated and new opportunities may not develop as quickly as we expect, or at all, limiting our ability to successfully sell our solutions."

The success of our products is founded on how we approach product development. We work closely with our customers, many of whom are thought leaders in genomics and medicine, to identify future frontiers and unmet needs. Once we identify the correct opportunities, which we create through both organic development by our in-house teams and targeted acquisitions of technologies that accelerate our ability to bring new products and new versions of existing products to researchers, we have the discipline to focus on execution and have a track record of bringing successful products across multiple portfolios to market. Multidisciplinary, cross-functional collaboration and technological innovation are central to our product development process. Our employees are deeply scientifically oriented, having the relevant scientific expertise embedded not only within research and development, but also within the management team and throughout the company. We have built teams with deep expertise across diverse disciplines including chemistry, molecular biology, microfluidics, hardware, computational biology and software engineering. We plan to focus our research and development efforts on improving the performance of our existing technologies, developing new solutions and new versions of existing solutions for our portfolios, improving and developing new capabilities for our instruments, developing combined software and workflows across multiple solutions and investigating and developing new technologies.

Since launching our first product in mid-2015, we have expanded our commercial operations and now sell our products in over 50 countries. Our customers primarily include academic, government, biopharmaceutical, biotechnology and other institutions focused on life sciences research. We sell our products primarily through our own direct sales force in North America and certain regions of Europe. As of December 31, 2025, our commercial organization consisted of 473 full time employees, many with PhD degrees and many with significant industry experience. We sell our products through third-party distributors in certain regions of Asia, Europe, Oceania, North America, South America, the Middle East and Africa.

paragraphs: Investing in our Class A common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks described below, as well as the other information in this Annual Report including our financial statements and the related notes and the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," before deciding whether to invest in our Class A common stock. The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and prospects. In such an event, the market price of our Class A common stock could decline and you may lose all or part of your investment. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial also may impair our business operations and the market price of our Class A common stock. In addition, you should consider the interrelationship and compounding effects of multiple risks occurring simultaneously.

Our business is subject to a number of risks, including risks that may prevent us from achieving our business objectives or may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and prospects. These risks are discussed more fully below and include, but are not limited to, risks related to:
Risks related to our business and industry: •Fluctuations in our operating results due to a variety of factors;
•Our dependency on the availability of funding, including government funding, to and research and development spending by research institutions;
•Our ability to compete effectively; •Our pricing strategy;
•Our ability to develop new products or new versions of existing products and enhance the capabilities of our existing products;

Our actual results could differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those set forth in the section titled "Risk Factors" under Part I, Item 1A above.

We are a life sciences technology company focused on building innovative products and solutions to interrogate, understand and master biology. Our integrated research solutions include instruments, consumables and software for analyzing biological systems at resolution and scale that matches the complexity of biology. Our commercial product portfolio is made up of our Single Cell and Spatial solutions. Our products include our instruments, which include our Chromium instruments, our Visium CytAssist and our Xenium Analyzer, and our consumables, which include proprietary microfluidic chips, slides, reagents and other consumables for our Single Cell and Spatial solutions. We bundle our software with these products to guide customers through the workflow, from sample preparation through analysis and visualization. Customers purchase instruments and consumables from us for use in their experiments. We also derive revenue from post-warranty service contracts for our instruments.

In August 2025, we entered into an agreement to acquire all outstanding shares of common stock of Scale Biosciences, Inc. ("Scale Bio"), a single cell genomics technology company. Upon closing the transaction in August 2025, we made an upfront payment consisting of $9.2 million in cash and $13.5 million (1,099,992 shares) in shares of our Class A common stock. In the first quarter of 2026, we expect to pay $20.0 million, subject to any adjustments, in cash and in shares of our Class A common stock in connection with the technology transfer completed in the third quarter of 2025. In the future, we may pay up to $30.0 million of contingent consideration if certain milestones are met.

The transaction was accounted for as an asset acquisition because substantially all of the fair value of the assets acquired is concentrated in the developed technology. We determined that the contingent consideration was within the scope of ASC 480, Distinguishing Liabilities from Equity, because the contingent consideration is payable in cash or shares of our Class A common stock, at our election. The contingent consideration was recorded at fair value as of the acquisition date. Upon closing, we recognized $22.4 million for the fair value of the contingent consideration. Refer to Note 4, Acquisitions, in the Notes to consolidated financial statements included in this Annual report on Form 10-K, for a description of the fair value measurement of the contingent consideration.

Our products are sold to academic and translational researchers and biopharmaceutical companies. Our Chromium and Visium CytAssist instruments are user installable and do not require in-person training. Our Xenium instrument requires installation and we offer in-person training for its use. We believe cumulative instruments sold is one of the indicators of our ability to drive customer adoption of our products. We define cumulative instruments sold as the cumulative number of Chromium instruments, Visium CytAssists and Xenium Analyzers sold since inception.

Our quarterly instrument unit volumes can fluctuate due to a number of factors, including the procurement and budgeting cycles of many of our customers and the availability of academic and government research funding. We also believe the timing of unit sales has been impacted and will continue to be impacted by the timing of product introductions and transitions which can either accelerate or delay demand of existing and new products or new versions of existing products depending on the needs of individual researchers to conclude existing studies or to use capabilities of new products or versions. Also, the timing and magnitude of our price changes can influence quarterly instrument unit volumes. For example, we believe that historical announcements of price changes have caused customers to pull forward purchases or postpone purchases of instruments. We therefore believe that an annual representation of cumulative instruments sold is most appropriate for assessing trends in our business.

A consumable reaction is the reagent setup needed to perform an experiment using one of our solutions. Reactions represent the unit volumes that we sell when a researcher purchases our consumables. As such, we believe consumable reactions sold is an appropriate metric for assessing trends in our business. paragraphs: 本公司之使命為加速對生物學的掌握，以促進人類健康。本公司為生命科學技術公司，專注於開發創新產品與解決方案，用以探討、理解與掌握生物學。本公司整合性研究解決方案包括儀器、消耗品與軟體，用以分析生物系統，其解析度與規模可與生物學的複雜性相匹配。本公司在化學、生物學、硬體與軟體等多樣領域建立了深厚的專業知識。這些領域的創新已促成本公司快速擴張的產品組合，使客戶得以以前所未有的解析度與規模探討生物系統。本公司產品已協助研究人員在生物學多個領域做出基礎發現，包括腫瘤學、免疫學與神經科學。

自2015年中推出首款產品至2025年12月31日，我們已向全球研究人員銷售8,046臺儀器，包括學術與轉譯研究人員及生物製藥公司。我們2025年度及2024年度的營業收入分別為642.8 百萬美元及610.8 百萬美元，較去年同期成長5%。我們2025年度及2024年度分別產生淨虧損43.5 百萬美元及182.6 百萬美元。2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日，我們分別銷售1,007臺及1,073臺儀器，以及424,000及357,100次消耗性反應試劑。截至目前為止，我們估計基於使用我們產品產生的數據，已有超過10,000篇同儕審查論文發表。

解析度與規模為本公司產品與技術的關鍵要素。首先，本公司解決方案設計用以在適當的生物學解析度層面理解生物學，例如在單細胞層面或組織與器官的高空間解析度層面。其次，本公司認為高解析度工具僅在與具有龐大規模的技術整合後，才能真正發揮其強大功能。本公司產品可測量數百萬個單細胞或組織樣本位置。每一個平台皆設計用以探討主要類別的生物資訊，使研究人員得以在空間與細胞層面理解生物學的複雜性。集體而言，本公司平台使研究人員得以在適當的解析度與規模層面探討、理解與掌握生物學。

本公司單細胞產品組，由Chromium平台驅動，包括微流體晶片與相關消耗品，以及Chromium X系列與舊版Chromium儀器。Chromium產品組可進行高通量分析個別生物零組件。Chromium儀器作為精確工程設計的試劑遞送系統，將樣本分為個別組分，其數量可超過一百萬。每一個組分皆與專利的凝膠珠結合，這些凝膠珠具有獨特的條碼，使研究人員得以識別每一個組分的內容，並與其他組分的內容區分。一旦生物材料在每一個組分中被條碼標記，即可將其混合並一起進行測序。組分與條碼標記的技術使研究人員得以測量許多不同的生物材料，或同時進行多種實驗，提供極高的解析度與規模。Chromium可提供多組學的測讀，包括基因表達、蛋白質（細胞表面與細胞內）、染色質、V(D)J、CRISPR/guide RNA（gRNA）與抗原，具有廣泛的樣本相容性（福爾馬林固定石蠟包埋（FFPE）、新鮮、新鮮凍存、paraformaldehyde（PFA）固定組織、DSP/甲醇固定外周血液單核細胞（PBMCs）與全血），並提供高表現性能，包括高細胞回收率（CRE）、高靈敏度、強健性與重複性。
本公司單細胞產品組也包括QuantumScale Single Cell RNA與Single Cell Methylation套件，這些產品係透過本公司於2025年收購Scale Biosciences, Inc.（"Scale Bio"）所取得。
本公司空間產品組由Visium與Xenium平台驅動，旨在結合組織學與基因組學的領域。

本公司Visium平台。本公司Visium平台使研究人員得以識別生物零組件的位置及其相對排列方式，否則稱為"空間分析"。本公司Visium平台使用高密度DNA陣列，這些陣列具有DNA條碼序列，用以編碼樣本中生物分析物的物理位置，例如組織切片，使研究人員能透過測序讀取生物分析物的空間位置，以建立樣本中生物分析物的視覺地圖。與組分標記類似，空間條碼標記透過陣列上大量寡核苷酸，可解鎖大量洞察，提供高解析度的分子資訊，以視覺化整個轉錄組與蛋白質表達，並與同個組織切片的蘇木精與伊紅（H&E）或紅外（IR）影像數據結合，應用於生物組織。Visium平台包括Visium CytAssist，這是一臺儀器，設計用以簡化與優化Visium解決方案的作業流程，透過協助將轉錄組分析物從標準玻璃載片轉移到Visium載片。此外，Visium平台也包含HD WT Panel基因表達與HD 3'基因表達檢測。
本公司也提供v2 WT Panel基因表達與v1 3'基因表達，這些為本公司第一代檢測方法。

我們的 Xenium 平台。我們的 Xenium 平台用於原位分析，設計為讓科學家不僅能在其組織背景中定位並識別細胞，也能根據對其樣本的先前知識，針對多種特定問題進行分析，這些知識可能透過我們的 Chromium 和 Visium 平台發現。我們的 Xenium Analyzer 裝置讓研究者能在新鮮凍結或 FFPE 組織切片中直接檢測並保留數百個 RNA 目標的細胞位置，而無需傳統的測序，提供研究者詳細的基因表現模式地圖，而不會犧牲解析度或目標數量。Xenium 使用可循環使用的探針，這些探針針對目標轉錄本，並透過酵素擴增來產生可供螢光探針雜交的目標。在 Xenium Analyzer 上，顯微鏡影像會檢測組織中每個螢光探針的位置，然後移除這些探針。經過多次螢光探針雜交、影像捕捉與移除後，會產生獨特的光學簽名，揭示每個組織細胞內某個位置的 RNA 身分。可用的 Xenium 消耗品包括經過篩選、驗證且符合用途的基因面板，以及設計自訂基因組合的能力。

我們的軟體對加速生物學的掌握至關重要。隨著我們的產品組合解鎖更高的解析度與規模，會產生比以往更大體積與複雜度的新類型數據。這種規模需要全新的儀器軟體與韌體的複雜度，才能使 Xenium 這樣的產品成為可能。與我們 Chromium 平台同時推出的 Cell Ranger，已成為科學文獻中受信賴的 scRNA-seq 處理流程。我們將相同的易用性、可擴展性與可靠性原則應用於所有產品平台，確保研究者能輕鬆地從原始數據轉化為發現。目前，我們提供一個全面且可擴展的軟體生態系統，支援研究工作流程的每個階段，從實驗規劃到數據處理、視覺化與探索。透過消除採用門檻，我們的工具協助研究者產生高品質數據、實現可重複的成功，並順利擴展其實驗。Loupe Browser（Chromium 和 Visium）提供直覺的單細胞、空間與多組學數據視覺化，協助研究者探索基因表現、細胞互動等內容——將複雜數據集轉化為互動式見解，加速發現。Xenium Explorer 提供直覺的原位數據視覺化，讓研究者能輕鬆探索亞細胞基因表現、空間組織與組織規模模式。它將複雜的影像與轉錄組數據轉化為互動式見解，加速空間生物學的發現。我們的目標是透過戰略合作夥伴關係擴展此生態系統，整合強大的軟體工具，進一步降低複雜數據分析的門檻，並加速生物學見解轉化為研究與臨牀進展。
{'translated_text': '我們認為，由於我們有能力回答廣泛的生物學問題，因此全球每年約750億美元的生命科學研究工具市場中，許多部分最終都可能對我們開放。我們估計，每年總可達市場規模超過210億美元，假設全球生命科學研究工具市場中每間實驗室或公司都採用我們的解決方案，且支出水平與現有用戶相當。我們估計，每年可服務的可達市場規模超過130億美元。'}

假設全球生命科學研究工具市場中，目前使用單細胞、空間或相關研究技術的每個實驗室或公司都採用我們的解決方案，且支出水平與現有用戶相當。我們也預期會追求其他機會，這些機會可能進一步擴大我們的潛在市場，包括未來單細胞、空間與原位技術的新版本與潛在應用。我們的估計基於我們自身與第三方對我們潛在機會的分析。請參閱標題為 "風險因素 — 我們解決方案的市場規模可能小於預估，且新機會可能不會如我們預期的速度發展，或完全不發展，這會限制我們成功銷售解決方案的能力" 的部分。

我們產品的成功建立在如何我們進行產品開發的策略上。我們與客戶密切合作，這些客戶中許多是基因組學與醫學領域的權威人士，以識別未來的發展方向與未滿足的需求。一旦我們識別出正確的機會，這些機會是透過我們內部團隊的內生開發與針對性收購技術來創造的，這些技術能加速我們將新產品與現有產品的新版本帶給研究者。我們有專注於執行的紀律，並有將成功產品跨多個產品組合推向市場的紀錄。跨學科、跨功能的協作與技術創新是我們產品開發過程的核心。我們的員工具有深厚的科學導向，相關科學專業知識不僅內嵌於研究與開發部門，也內嵌於管理團隊與公司各處。我們已建立跨多個學科的專業團隊，包括化學、分子生物學、微流體學、硬體、計算生物學與軟體工程。我們計畫將研究與開發的重點放在改善現有技術的表現、開發新解決方案與現有解決方案的新版本、改善與開發儀器的新功能、開發跨多個解決方案的軟體與工作流程，並研究與開發新技術。

自 2015 年中推出首個產品以來，我們已擴展商業運營，目前在超過 50 個國家銷售產品。我們的客戶主要包括專注於生命科學研究的學術機構、政府機構、生物製藥、生物科技及其他機構。我們主要透過自己的直接銷售團隊在北美與歐洲某些地區銷售產品。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的商業團隊由 473 名全職員工組成，其中許多擁有博士學位，且許多擁有豐富的產業經驗。我們透過第三方經銷商在亞洲、歐洲、大洋洲、北美、南美、中東與非洲的部分地區銷售產品。

paragraphs: 您應配合本公司的審計合併財務報表及其相關附註，以及本年度報告其他部分所載之其他財務資訊，一併閱讀有關我們財務狀況與營運成果之討論內容。
如「特別提醒有關向前看聲明」一節所述，本節討論與分析，除歷史財務資訊外，亦包含向前看聲明，這些聲明涉及風險與不確定性。我們實際結果可能與這些向前看聲明所預期者有重大差異，原因可能包括於第一部分，項目 1A 所述「風險因素」一節中所列之因素。

本公司為一生命科學技術公司，專注於開發創新產品與解決方案，以探討、理解並掌握生物學。我們整合的研發解決方案包含儀器、消耗品與軟體，用以分析生物系統，其解析度與規模可與生物學的複雜性相匹配。我們的商業產品組合包含單細胞與空間解決方案。我們的產品包括儀器，包含我們的 Chromium 儀器、Visium CytAssist 與 Xenium Analyzer，以及消耗品，包含專利微流體晶片、載玻片、試劑及其他消耗品，用於我們的單細胞與空間解決方案。我們將軟體與這些產品捆綁，以引導客戶完成工作流程，從樣本準備至分析與視覺化。客戶向我們購買儀器與消耗品，用於其實驗。我們亦從儀器的保固期後服務合約中獲取收入。

2025 年 8 月，我們與 Scale Biosciences, Inc.（"Scale Bio"），一家單細胞基因組學技術公司，簽訂協議，取得其所有發行在外的普通股。於 2025 年 8 月交易完成後，我們支付一筆 upfront 金額，包含 9.2 百萬美元現金與 13.5 百萬美元（1,099,992 股）本公司 A 級普通股。於 2026 年第一季，我們預期支付 20.0 百萬美元現金與本公司 A 級普通股，視技術轉移於 2025 年第三季完成後之調整而定。未來，若達成特定里程碑，我們可能支付最高達 30.0 百萬美元之附條件補償金。

此交易被視為資產取得，因取得之資產中，幾乎全部公允價值集中於已開發技術。我們判斷附條件補償金屬於 ASC 480，區分負債與權益之範疇，因附條件補償金以現金或本公司 A 級普通股支付，由本公司選擇。附條件補償金於取得日以公允價值計入。交易完成後，我們確認 22.4 百萬美元為附條件補償金之公允價值。請參閱本年度報告 10-K 表單中所附合併財務報表附註之附註 4，「取得」，以瞭解附條件補償金之公允價值衡量方法。
我們定期評估多項運營與財務指標，包括累計儀器銷售數量與總消耗品反應數量，以評估我們的業務、衡量我們的表現、識別影響我們業務的趨勢、制定財務預測並做出戰略決策。我們認為這些指標代表我們目前的業務；
然而，我們預期這些指標可能隨業務成長或我們推出新產品或新版本的現有產品而改變，或被其他指標取代。

我們的產品銷售對象為學術機構與轉譯研究者以及生物製藥公司。我們的 Chromium 與 Visium CytAssist 儀器為用戶可自行安裝，不需親自培訓。我們的 Xenium 儀器則需安裝，並提供親自培訓以供使用。我們認為累計銷售儀器數量為衡量我們推動客戶採用產品能力的重要指標。我們定義累計銷售儀器數量為自成立以來銷售的 Chromium 儀器、Visium CytAssist 與 Xenium Analyzer 總數。

我們的季度儀器單元銷售量可能因多種因素而波動，包括許多客戶的採購與預算週期，以及學術與政府研究經費的可取得性。我們也認為銷售單元的時間點受到產品發佈與過渡時點的影響，這可能會加速或延遲現有與新產品或新版本產品的需求，取決於個別研究者是否需要結束現有研究或使用新產品或版本的功能。此外，我們價格變動的時間與幅度也會影響季度儀器單元銷售量。例如，我們認為歷史上的價格變動公告導致客戶提前或延後購買儀器。因此，我們認為以年度表現來觀察累計銷售儀器數量，最適合評估我們業務的趨勢。

消耗性反應為執行實驗所需的試劑設置，使用我們的解決方案之一。反應代表我們在研究者購買消耗性產品時所銷售的單元數量。因此，我們認為消耗性反應銷售量為評估我們業務趨勢的適當指標。上表中的數字（四捨五入至百位）代表截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日、2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日，依產品平台分類的總消耗性反應數量及總計。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Chromium Single Cell 反應包括 Chromium 與 Scale Bio 反應。

paragraphs: 投資本公司的A類普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險，以及本年度報告中其他資訊，包括財務報表及相關附註，以及標題為『管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析』的章節，再決定是否投資本公司的A類普通股。如發生下列任何事件或發展，可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流及前景造成損害。在這種情況下，本公司A類普通股的市場價格可能會下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。下列所描述的風險與不確定性並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前本公司尚未知悉，或目前認為不重要，也可能影響本公司業務運作及A類普通股的市場價格。此外，您應考慮多種風險同時發生時的相互影響與累加效果。
本公司業務面臨許多風險，包括可能使本公司無法達成業務目標，或對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流及前景造成不利影響的風險。這些風險在下文有更詳細的說明，包括但不限於與本公司業務及產業相關的風險：
與本公司業務及產業相關的風險：•因多種因素導致本公司營運成果波動；
•對資金可取得性的依賴，包括政府資金，以及研究機構的研究與開發支出；
•本公司有效競爭的能力；•本公司定價策略；
•本公司開發新產品或現有產品的新版本，並提升現有產品功能的能力；
